description: Only in a build with downloads (the `downloads` Cargo feature, ATLAS_ENABLE_DOWNLOADS=1): the main window's commands for downloading map images and their settings, for downloading the location photos a pack lists to be fetched later (or only the pictures of its types, the icons of the map it was read from), for measuring which map images of an imported map exist, for reading pages for an importer that fetches them, for asking for the whole pictures of maps an importer names and cutting them into map images until the game is saved, for the 3D models of maps an importer reads (fetching a model from the site, or taking the model an importer made from a game's own files, building it with Atlas's 3D builder, and throwing away builds no saved game took), for reading a game's own files in a folder the person picks in the system's folder dialog (listing it and reading its files, read-only, nothing outside it, until it is closed), for the app's own folder of the files an importer downloads for a kind of game once the person has confirmed they own it (opening it, and downloading one file at a time into it as the app, only the file asked for), for reading back the style sheets kept for a game to lay its saved pages out as a browser shows them, for viewing a map page and saving its images as the person browses, and for the Sites folder of the person's site rules files (listing, adding a chosen file, removing one, keeping which are switched on, and saving the guide and the schema for writing one), and for keeping pack files of the games read from sites up to date in one folder the person chooses in the system's folder dialog (the setting, its state, writing all packs now or one again, stopping, and opening that folder). No other window is granted anything.
